answer: Anyone running 169 aliases therefore needs 200 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in pigment, expire in prism, and hollow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2724 identities would post 4929 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
